reason: The goal is to give the potato stems room, and the cargo mesh may provide a support for them.
expectation: I expect the mesh to become some kind of support for the growing potato plants, though I’m not sure how it will be fitted.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce is ready to harvest, but supporting the potato stems is the stated goal.

effect: The mesh supports the spreading potato stems, and the next goal is to taste the first harvest.
reaction: It is satisfying to see how the grid fits around the bed while leaving the root cover in place.
reason: The lettuce is ready, and cutting it is the only numbered combination offered.
expectation: I expect to harvest lettuce that can be prepared or eaten, though another step may be needed.

effect: The harvest leaves the central lettuce leaves growing, and the fresh leaves can now go to the galley.
reaction: I like the detail that the bed can keep growing after this small harvest.
reason: Taking the lettuce to the galley is the only numbered action and should help with the goal of tasting it.
expectation: I expect to prepare or taste the lettuce, though I don't know exactly what the galley step will do.

effect: The galley step washed the lettuce and added it to a meal, completing the harvest goal.
reaction: The sharp green smell against the barren view is a vivid payoff for growing the lettuce.

mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the outer lettuce leaves was most worthwhile: leaving the center growing showed a useful way to take a small harvest while the plant continues to grow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Taking the leaves to the galley was straightforward and the only offered action, though the resulting meal provided a pleasant payoff.

surprise.text: I was interested that the potato stems could lean on a grid while the root cover stayed in place.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to supporting the potatoes or eating the lettuce.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see the potatoes develop and how the longer wait pays off, especially after the contrast between the fresh meal and the landscape outside.
